title: ImUi Color Edit Popup Options v1
problem: Close the next bounded Dear ImGui `ColorEdit4` option/default gap by making the editor-owned `ColorEdit` popup defaults explicit per control, without adding global `SetColorEditOptions()` state, color history, drag/drop payloads, eyedropper behavior, HueWheel rendering, or runtime contract changes.

repro.summary: Editor `ColorEdit` now exposes `ColorEditPopupOptions` with explicit HueBar picker, RGB/HSV numeric row, preset palette, and AlphaBar visibility defaults, and app authors can configure those options through the existing `ColorEditOptions` path.
commands: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-editor --features imui color_edit --no-fail-fast
cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-editor --features imui --test imui_surface_policy --no-fail-fast
cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-editor --features imui --test imui_adapter_smoke --no-fail-fast
